chief_complaint: I haven't been sleeping well for the past month.
symptom_onset: about 4 weeks ago, after a stressful project deadline
symptoms: difficulty falling asleep, usually takes over an hour
wakes up around 3am and can't fall back asleep
feels tired and unfocused during the day
medical_history: no chronic illness, no prior sleep problems before this
medication: occasionally takes over-the-counter melatonin, not consistently
lifestyle: drinks coffee in the afternoon, uses phone in bed before sleeping, irregular bedtime
emotional_context: worried the tiredness will affect her job performance, a bit embarrassed to admit she scrolls her phone at night
hidden_information: she has been under a lot of stress from a recent breakup, which she won't mention unless asked about her mood or personal life
she has been skipping dinner some days and eating a large meal right before bed
expected_topics: onset and duration of sleep trouble
sleep pattern details (falling asleep vs staying asleep)
forbidden_information: she does not know any TCM diagnosis or pattern name for her own condition
teaching_objectives: practice history-taking questions about sleep quality and duration
practice asking about lifestyle and emotional contributing factors
practice giving simple English health education about sleep hygiene

hidden_information: he grinds his teeth at night, which he only recently found out from his partner

forbidden_information: he does not know any TCM diagnosis or pattern name for his own condition
teaching_objectives: practice distinguishing tension-type headache features through questioning
practice asking about posture, screen time, and stress as contributing factors
practice giving lifestyle-based health education in English

pain sometimes radiates to the lower back
occasional nausea during the worst pain
severity: moderate to severe, sometimes needs to take sick leave
associated_symptoms: cold hands and feet during her period
medical_history: no diagnosed gynecological condition, has never had an ultrasound

hidden_information: she has noticed the pain is worse on months when she is under more stress at work
she rarely drinks warm water and often has iced drinks even during her period
expected_topics: timing, location, and severity of the pain
how long she has had period pain and whether it has changed
impact on daily life and work

practice asking about TCM-relevant lifestyle factors (cold exposure, diet)
practice giving lifestyle-based health education about menstrual pain
